# Pricing table — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the pricing table when plans need comparing: one card per plan in a labelled pricing region. `plans` are data — id, name, price, blurb, features, highlighted, badge — so the comparison is one declaration, with `onSelect` receiving the chosen plan id and `selectLabel` overriding the button text. The highlight is an outlined card plus badge pill: emphasis without reordering the plans, and the recommended option announces as marked rather than just painted. There is no payment capture — selecting reports the plan while checkout stays host-owned — and no currency formatting, because prices arrive as localised nodes and the table never computes.
